subject: Clarifications: metering, billing & integration for marketplace listing
messages:
From: Kate Emerson <kate.emerson@novacloud.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: marketplace-team@awsmarketplace.com
Date: Sat, 03 Oct 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Metering and billing integration questions for Redwood listing

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the draft listing details — procurement is working through a short checklist for the cloud marketplace procurement team and had a couple of technical clarifications before we proceed to legal and finance sign-off. Can you confirm the following for AWS Marketplace (we'll replicate for Azure/GCP after):

1) Metering semantics: will Redwood report per-token usage (in total tokens) or per-call token buckets? We need the exact dimension to map to our internal billing pipelines.

2) Metering frequency and latency: what is the typical delay between usage occurring and the marketplace metering event being exported? Is there a guaranteed window for reporting (e.g., within 1 hour / 24 hours)?

3) Price escalation and billing consumption: how are discounts applied when customers come via a marketplace subscription vs direct invoicing? We need a standard example scenario showing list price -> marketplace price -> reseller discount stacking (if applicable).

4) Entitlement enforcement: does Redwood support SKU-based entitlements so we can gate feature flags / capacity limits from our side? If so, which fields in the entitlement payload should we expect?

5) Evidence for procurement: they requested SOC2 + metering cert screenshots and any historical metering event samples (sanitized). We can accept XLSX stubs for ingestion.

If you can respond by Monday morning PST we can keep our listing window for mid-October. Attaching our marketplace intake template for reference (not included).

Appreciate it — Kate

Kate Emerson
Senior Manager, Cloud Procurement
NovaCloud Marketplace

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Kate Emerson <kate.emerson@novacloud.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com, marketplace-team@awsmarketplace.com
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Metering and billing integration questions for Redwood listing

Hi Kate — thanks for the clear list. See answers inline below; attaching a metering matrix and an RFI pdf that should help your ingestion team.

1) Metering semantics:
- Redwood reports usage as "compute_token_units" (a single numeric counter representing tokens consumed by generation and embedding calls). We also provide call-level dimensions for: model_id, deployment_tier (hosted/dedicated), and customer_id (masked marketplace entitlement id).
- For downstream reconciliation we can export a per-call CSV (timestamp, customer_masked_id, model_id, tokens, call_id) on request for onboarding partners.

2) Metering frequency and latency:
- Real-time aggregation: events are batched and emitted every 5 minutes to our internal metering pipeline.
- Marketplace export window: we push consolidated daily files (UTC day) to the marketplace ingestion endpoint; typical arrival is within 24 hours of usage. For high-priority enterprise partners we can enable intra-day pushes (hourly) under a dedicated contract.

3) Price escalation and billing consumption:
- Marketplace listing price is independent from direct SaaS pricing. We publish list_price_usd per SKU in the listing.
- Marketplace discounts: marketplace price replaces list price for transactions processed by the marketplace billing flow. If a reseller/partner discount is in place, end-customer invoicing is reflected as net_price in the marketplace report (we can include both gross and net columns).
- Example: SKU list_price_usd=100/month; marketplace_list_price=90/month; reseller_discount=10% -> marketplace_report shows gross=90, net=81.

4) Entitlement enforcement:
- Yes: Redwood supports SKU-based entitlements and enforcement via a JWT-bearing entitlement token passed with each request. Entitlement payload contains: entitlement_id, sku_id, allowed_tokens_per_month, expiry_ts, and tier_flags (comma-separated).
- We honor both server-side enforcement (rejecting requests when exceeded) and soft-limit alerts (continue serving + reporting) depending on the agreed integration mode.

5) Evidence for procurement:
- SOC2 Type II: certificate available at https://drive.redwood.com/shared/compliance/soc2-2026.pdf (we included a time-limited download in the RFI pdf).
- Metering samples: attached redwood_metering_matrix_v1.xlsx with sanitized per-customer event rows and a summary sheet. The RFI pdf has an export sample for marketplace format.

Next steps: if the daily consolidated file + SKU entitlement approach works for NovaCloud, we'll draft a short appendix to the SOW that covers the hourly export option and the permissioning of net_price fields for reconciliation.

Attaching: redwood_metering_matrix_v1.xlsx, marketplace_rfi_answers_20261003.pdf

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0147

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Metering and billing integration questions for Redwood listing

Ben / Grace — looping in a couple of quick product clarifications before Ben sends the final appendix to procurement:

- For SKU-based entitlements, we need to agree on the default behavior for soft limits vs hard enforcement. Sales prefers soft by default with a hard enforcement on a customer-by-customer basis (to avoid breakage during onboarding). Please confirm the default and add a short clause for the SOW.

- Security: procurement may ask for the public key we use to sign entitlement JWTs. Recommend we provide a rotating JWKS endpoint and note key rotation policy (30 days). Grace, can you add the JWKS URL and rotation cadence to the RFI pdf?

- Billing: product ops wants to ensure we expose both gross_gcp/azure/aws and net_price in the marketplace export. We should standardize column names in the attached metering_matrix. Ben, please check the xlsx and confirm column names match what you sent.

Happy to take action once we have those items.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Partnerships

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Kate Emerson <kate.emerson@novacloud.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com, marketplace-team@awsmarketplace.com
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 14:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Metering and billing integration questions for Redwood listing

Hi Kate — quick follow up. Based on internal feedback we've finalized the defaults and added the JWKS endpoint to the RFI pdf (see attached). Summary of changes: 

- Default enforcement mode: soft-limit with alerts (we will not hard-stop traffic unless a customer requests hard enforcement in writing).
- JWKS endpoint: https://keys.redwood.com/.well-known/jwks.json (rotation cadence 30 days).
- Export column updates: gross_price, marketplace_price, reseller_discount_pct, net_price, tokens_consumed, timestamp_utc, sku_id, customer_masked_id.

I've re-uploaded marketplace_rfi_answers_20261003.pdf with the new JWKS and column names and re-sent the metering_matrix with example rows. If you want an hourly export we can include an appendix to the SOW and scope the increased ingestion SLA.

Would you like us to prepare the SOW appendix and a short technical handoff doc for your platform ingestion team? We can have a draft by Friday.

Regards,
Ben
